title: When a Snowsports School Booking Counts as Delivered and When Its Record Is Closed
content:
A Snowsports School booking is delivered when the block of sessions it holds has run out, and the date of the last session is written to the record.

## What a delivered booking earns

A delivered booking earns the participant a written progress card at the ability level they reached, which the school uses to place them the next time they book.

## When a record may be closed

A booking record is closed only when nothing is left to collect against it and no school credit issued on it is left to spend. Both are read from the booking record itself, matched by the booking reference: the amount still to be collected on the booking and the school credit standing on it must each stand at nothing before the record is closed.

Closing is the last write on the record and nothing is added to it afterwards; a household who wants more instruction opens a fresh booking rather than reopening this one.

## Bookings that end before the block runs out

A booking that ends without every session being delivered is closed on the terms that applied when it ended, so a cancelled booking closes once its credit has been issued and a missed booking closes once its fee has been settled.

## The closing condition put as a table

| Amount still to be collected | School credit still standing | Record may be closed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| nothing | nothing | yes |
| an amount outstanding | nothing | no |
| nothing | credit still standing | no |
| an amount outstanding | credit still standing | no |

## Readings

- A booking whose block held six sessions stands as delivered once the sixth has been delivered, and the date of that session is written to the record.
- A booking given up before any session ran is closed once the credit due on it has been issued and nothing is left to collect against it.
- A booking marked as missed is closed once the fee raised on it has been settled and no credit issued on it is left to spend.

The session counts, programme weeks and video analysis inclusion these rules speak of are published product by product on the Snowsports School tariff.
